problem_type: Desktop specimen transport and capability advertisement diverge
symptom: Creation lab reserves no Agent column and its editor expands underneath the Agent panel; root readiness may be true while the lazy workspace still displays a loader.
direct_cause: CreationColumnsStage and ShellStage connected laneClient directly without exposing the fixture transport as nomiDesktop.agentLane; production WorkbenchShell now derives dock visibility from that capability.
class_root: The lab fixture host had separate owners for transport data and advertised capabilities, and screenshot readiness did not require nested workspace completion.
affected_population: agent-panel-v4 shell specimens and their walkthrough consumers
internal_only_reason: This is an internal fixture ownership invariant. Product capability detection and third-party runtime behavior are unchanged.
invariants: The advertised Agent bridge is the exact read-only transport consumed by the specimen.
Fixture disposal restores prior host capabilities.
A visible lazy workspace loader cannot be accepted as a completed specimen.

door_reduction.why_not: Two domain specimen consumers use the shared lifecycle hook; the hook uses one installer. Tests separately read and exercise the installer. These are distinct responsibilities rather than duplicate transport owners.

generality_proof: Both shell specimen families install their transport and advertise it through installLabLane. Shared screenshot assertions reject workspace loading placeholders and enforce the creation dock grid before pixel comparison.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own the read-only fixture bridge and host restoration.
Wait for nested real workspace and validate the Agent dock layout before screenshots.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Replaced direct laneClient.connect with shared host installation.
Uses the same installer and cleanup boundary.

recurrence.reason: Every fixture that connects only projection data can diverge from production capability guards after host-aware changes.
same_class_scan: rg labHostState and laneClient.connect src/devlab tests/ux

prevention.invariant: Fixture capability identity and consumed lane transport have one owner.
prevention.failure_mode: Commands reject without external effects; semantic browser assertions fail before screenshot comparison if the dock layout is missing.
prevention.strategy: Consolidate both fixture host families and assert actual workspace completion.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed duplicate laneClient.connect setup; both consumers use the shared installer.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The repaired host invariant is internal. Playwright screenshot engine, pinned dependencies and tolerance remain unchanged.

migration: No persisted product data or production host behavior changes. Existing browser lab specimens use the shared advertised fixture bridge.
residual_risks: Native glyph raster differences remain against the previously approved darwin baselines; no baseline refresh is authorized by this contract.
